audience.text: Builders, architects, developers, real estate agents in Orange County: this is for you.

problem.text: Land to keys takes four-plus years, and one missing document could delay it by months and cause real financial losses.

purpose.text: HouseX checks your plan set against the city's permit requirements, before you submit.

demo.text: Upload your plans. In under two minutes, see the missing documents and code conflicts.

payoff.text: Fewer correction rounds, less loan interest, lower consulting fees. For Habitat for Humanity, that's more money for homes.
